svg.text: Receives typed data, resolves geometry, emits display items
The svg_engine crate is a self-contained rendering module that converts raw SVG element data and
computed styles into optimized GPU display commands, with no direct DOM access.

g.text: EXTERNAL INPUT — From Layout Integration Layer
Builds a hierarchical tree from SVG DOM — groups become nodes with children, state is inherited
root: SvgRenderNode, viewport: ViewportInfo // Scene container
tag, geometry, fill, stroke, // Per-element data
transform, opacity, clip_path → NOT stored here, tracked by renderer state
Recursive tree walk: per node, resolve SvgLength → pixels, apply inherited state
resolve_len(v: &Option<SvgLength>, ref_len: f32, default: f32) → f32
Tree walk: push/pop state per node
Rect, Circle, Ellipse, Line, // P0 — Basic shapes
Path, Polyline, Polygon, G, Svg, // P0 — Paths + structure
Text, Use, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, // P1 — Text + gradients
Image, Defs, Unknown // P2 — Future / edge case
P0 = first milestone · P1 = follow-up · P2 = if time permits
Rect { x, y, width, height, rx, ry: Option<SvgLength> },
Ellipse { cx, cy, rx, ry: Option<SvgLength> },
Line { x1, y1, x2, y2: Option<SvgLength> },
All numeric fields are Option<SvgLength> — unresolved at parse time.
pub color: Option<ColorF>, // None = no fill
pub color: Option<ColorF>, pub width: f32,
pub opacity: f32, pub linecap: SvgLineCap,
pub linejoin: SvgLineJoin, pub miterlimit: f32,
pub dasharray: Option<Vec<f32>>, pub dashoffset: f32,
root: SvgRenderNode, // Root of rendering tree
tag: SvgTag, // Element type (Rect, Circle, G, ...)
fill: FillParams, stroke: StrokeParams, // Style per element
RenderState { transform, clip_path, opacity } — NOT stored per-node, tracked by renderer during tree walk
Core data types: SvgTag, ParsedGeometry, FillParams, StrokeParams, SvgRenderNode
Style extraction from stylo ComputedValues (fill, stroke, geometry, opacity)
SVG length parsing: SvgLength enum (Px, Percent) with resolution
Tree walk renderer: push_rect, push_border, push_reference_frame, define_clip
SVG path data attribute parsing → BezPath curve representation
SVG transform attribute parsing (matrix, translate, scale, rotate, etc.)
